rationale: General mineralization and interfacial-water background; not HAP-specific and not evidence of HAP performance.
Direct HAP surface and water-adsorption evidence candidate; broader hydrated-interface wording still requires scope review.
Most direct CO2-on-HAP candidate, deferred because an approved accessible full text is not currently available.
Direct comparison of water adsorption on named HAP facets; reserved for a later extraction wave.
Compares water reactivity on carbonated apatite and HAP; carbonate substitution must not be conflated with CO2 reaction.
Directly relevant spectroscopy and microscopy candidate with HCl, biological-apatite, and maturity scope limits.
Supports CP2K electronic-structure and AIMD capabilities; repository runs exist but none are manuscript-eligible.
Potential context for hydroxyl-dependent surface structure, not direct hydrated-interface evidence.
Apatite gas-adsorption context that must not be equated with hydrated mineralization.
Scope-boundary candidate limited to high-temperature capture and carbonation at 500 °C; not a direct precedent for ambient hydrated interfaces.
MatterGen invocation code exists, but no campaign output, summary, or qualifying manifest is present.
MACE conversion code and input templates exist, but no model or qualifying run artifact is present.
DeepMD conversion and training configuration exist, but no populated dataset or validated model is present.
The slab script only announces a pymatgen plan and does not import or execute surface construction.
LAMMPS input templates exist, but no manuscript-eligible production run is present.
Enhanced-sampling and PLUMED files are empty placeholders; reassess only after implementation and actual use.
Prior active-learning MLIP for bulk HAP (OH reorientation); limits any claim of a first HAP MLIP. No water interface or CO2.
Prior MLIP-assisted study of a reaction on HAP surfaces with defects; methane, not CO2 or hydrated interfaces.
Prior MLIP for aqueous calcium phosphate clusters; shows Ca-P-O-H in water has been modelled, without CO2 or a crystal surface.
SCAN Deep Potential for CaCO3 from solution to solid; the pipeline's accuracy reference and the closest carbonate MLIP precedent.
Closest mechanism precedent: CO2 mineralization steps on portlandite under a nanometric water film with metadynamics; not an apatite and not an ab initio MLIP.
Method precedent for metadynamics-driven active learning of reactive MLIPs in water; biased exploration is therefore not itself a novelty.
Benchmarks generative models against ion-exchange baselines and reports stability rates below published S.U.N. rates; precedent for the attrition finding.
MatterSim phonons for 133,838 generated crystals; MatterGen 45 % dynamically stable at -0.1 THz. Precedent for low dynamical stability of generated structures.
Static DFT of CO2 and other probe molecules on HAP(0001); precedent for CO2-HAP surface energetics without water dynamics.
Deep Potential for a mineral-water interface; shows DP for mineral-water interfaces is established practice.
AIMD of water/scCO2/silicate interfaces with carbonate formation near cation vacancies; DFT-level carbonation precedent on another mineral class.
Closest conceptual precedent for coupling structure search with MLIP active learning; structure prediction, not reaction-product coverage.
